name: Ouryumon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] You may place 1 card with the [X Antibody] trait from your hand under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card to delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 7 or less.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your effects places a digivolution card under one of your Digimon, this Digimon gets +2000 DP and can't be deleted by your opponent's effects until the end of your opponent's next turn.
source_effect: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Alphamon] in its name, unsuspend it.
